description: This file defines the TabController class which manages system and user-specific tab configurations within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, setting, and restoring tabs, handling cache validation, and interacting with the Administration bean for persistent storage of settings.

classes.name: TabController
classes.description: Manages the retrieval, update, and organization of system and user-specific tab configurations within SuiteCRM, including cache management and permissions.

methods.name: is_system_tabs_in_db
methods.description: Checks whether system tabs are stored in the database settings.

methods.name: get_system_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves system tabs configuration, utilizing caching and ensuring saved modules exist.

methods.name: get_tabs_system
methods.description: Returns the system tabs and unset tabs, with iframe visibility consideration.

methods.name: set_system_tabs
methods.description: Stores the given system tabs configuration into the database settings.

methods.name: get_users_can_edit
methods.description: Checks if users are permitted to edit tabs based on settings.

methods.name: set_users_can_edit
methods.description: Sets whether users can edit their tabs preferences, restricted to admins.

methods.name: get_key_array
methods.description: Converts an array of values into an associative array with keys equal to values.

methods.name: get_user_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves user preferences for tabs, falling back to system defaults if none set.

methods.name: get_unset_tabs
methods.description: Returns the list of modules not set as user tabs.

methods.name: get_old_user_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves the previous format of user tabs, filtered by system configuration.

methods.name: get_old_tabs
methods.description: Gets old user tabs and corresponding system tabs for comparison or migration.

methods.name: get_tabs
methods.description: Returns the combined view of display, hidden, and removed tabs, respecting permissions.

methods.name: restore_tabs
methods.description: Restores user tabs to default module list.

methods.name: restore_system_tabs
methods.description: Resets system tabs to default module list.
